novel_features.name: Daily snapshot delta
novel_features.description: One-line 'where you stand right now' for every playlist with today vs yesterday MMR and tier delta.

novel_features.name: Time-series MMR curve
novel_features.description: Daily MMR series for one playlist over N days, suitable for piping into an agent or charting tool.

novel_features.name: Session summary
novel_features.description: Closes today's play session: start vs current MMR, W/L, most-played playlist.

novel_features.name: Group ranker
novel_features.description: Multi-player diff for a saved friend group, sortable by MMR delta, win delta, or MVP delta over N days.

novel_features.name: Save a friend group
novel_features.description: Save a named friend group to local storage so the group ranker can query it.

novel_features.name: Agent context blob
novel_features.description: Single agent-shaped JSON envelope: identity + last-30-day per-playlist MMR series + last 20 matches + current rank/tier + sweat-delta. Token-budgeted via --select.

novel_features.name: Promo distance
novel_features.description: How many MMR points and approximate wins until the next tier promotion, per playlist.

novel_features.name: Tournament fit
novel_features.description: Lists active tournaments whose skill bracket includes the player's current MMR for the relevant playlist.

novel_features.name: Best queue time
novel_features.description: From historical population snapshots, the hour of week with the largest active queue for a playlist.

novel_features.name: MMR sparkline
novel_features.description: ASCII sparkline of MMR over the last 30 days for the chosen playlist.

novel_features.name: Liar check
novel_features.description: Verifies a player's claimed rank against their actual current MMR; returns 'true' or 'overstated by N MMR'.

novel_features.name: Import collector snapshot
novel_features.description: Pulls a JSON snapshot exported by the rocket-league-stats apps/collector process into the CLI's local store.
